svg.title: Known-best packing of 68 unit squares, regularized
svg.desc: A regularized derived view of the retained known-best n=68 construction, never the source witness: Evan Daniel's regularizer's view of it, its contacts re-solved exactly at the record's side, verified over the rationals (atlas/known-best/regularized/index.json), and rendered with the repository's deterministic house renderer. It changes no side, frontier value or evidence tier; the evidence stated here is the record's. Regularized by the Squares Project with Evan Daniel's regularizer (evand/square-packing, MIT).

sqpack:profile.sqpack:value: Exact rational corners from the retained centered source, checked with exact predicates at the full rational side. Drawing feasibility does not assign the imported result's confirmation rung. No optimality, rigidity or human oversight claim.

svg.text: U n=68 regularized: side ~ 8.798795237 (certified upper bound)
